decisions.thought: Gholdengo blocks status and spins value, Kingambit is a strong win condition, and Sylveon covers opposing Dragon/Fighting types and provides Wish support. This core covers each other's weaknesses well.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Pick strong core: Gholdengo, Kingambit, Sylveon? Or lead Garchomp with sash for rocks. Common: Gholdengo, Kingambit, Sylveon covers fairy/steel. Bring Gholdengo, Kingambit, Sylveon.

decisions.thought: Garchomp is the strongest lead into the opponent’s Steel-heavy options, while Primarina covers their Dragons and Rotom-W adds speed control and a check to Garchomp. This trio gives the broadest matchup coverage.
